name: Johor Night Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun
short_description: The Johor Night Half Marathon 2026 was run on the evening of 25 July 2026 from Persiaran Medini 5, Iskandar Puteri, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Johor Night Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun took place on 25 July 2026, starting at 8.00pm from Persiaran Medini 5 in Iskandar Puteri, Johor, in front of Sunway Big Box. Unusually for the region it was run at night rather than before dawn, and offered a 5 km fun run, a 10 km fun run and a 21.1 km competitive half marathon. This edition has been run; the listing is kept as a record of it.

core_facts.venue: Persiaran Medini 5, Iskandar Puteri (in front of Sunway Big Box)

faqs.question: When was the Johor Night Half Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race was held on the evening of Saturday 25 July 2026, flagged off at 8.00pm from Persiaran Medini 5 in Iskandar Puteri. An evening start is unusual in Malaysia, where most road races set off in the small hours to avoid the daytime heat.

faqs.question: Where did the Johor Night Half Marathon 2026 start?
faqs.answer: The start line was on Persiaran Medini 5 in Iskandar Puteri, Johor, directly in front of Sunway Big Box. All three categories -- the 5 km fun run, the 10 km fun run and the 21.1 km competitive half marathon -- set off from the same point.
